task: structure-only molecular regression; extrapolation to unseen nonempty Murcko scaffolds
primary_comparisons: GCN and GINE full-spectrum heat vs base and MLP on Lipophilicity and ThermoSol (8 contrasts; Holm family)
limitations: Endpoints and hypotheses selected after pilot and the historical benchmark audit. New folds do not constitute an untouched external cohort. Lipophilicity and ThermoSol share 1088 molecules.
split: five shuffled balanced scaffold-group folds; each molecule tested once; approximately 70/10/20 train/validation/test; acyclic entries grouped by canonical molecule
selection: same two-candidate validation-only learning-rate budget for each neural family and variant; test evaluated only for selected candidate
primary_metric: molecule-weighted out-of-fold MAE; average per-molecule absolute error over initialization seeds, not error of ensemble prediction
uncertainty: paired scaffold-cluster bootstrap of unique OOF molecule errors; resample whole scaffolds, preserve molecule weights; conditional on fitted models, not full retraining uncertainty
mechanism_controls: complete zero-eigenspace projection including disconnected components
promotion: No general superiority or causal diffusion claim unless primary adjusted comparisons and attribution controls support it. Preserve negative results.
legacy: jcim_v2_full is retained as exploratory historical evidence; never overwrite or mix with v3
